title: Data does not upload to Nightscout after switch the Insulin type to Lyumjev
symptom: After switching insulin type to Lyumjev in AAPS configuration builder, the child's phone does not upload data to Nightscout and Dexcom Follow app stops showing sugar data. Switching back to rapid insulin resolves the issue.
cause: The thread suggests the issue may be caused by a combination of changing insulin type, Google Family Link parental controls, and manually changing the clock for summer time, which can cause synchronization problems.
fix: Switching back to rapid insulin resolved the issue. Additionally, the maintainer advises to avoid manually setting time as it can cause synchronization troubles.
evidence_quote: Only After we switched back to "rapid insulin" everything worked out and we could see data in Nightscout site and in the Dexcom Follow app
